Ji Ping Poisons
(Chapter Fifteen of Romance of the Three Kingdoms)
Adapted by Ji Zhi Xi
Illustrated by Qian Xiaodai
summary_zh: 本页为绘本《吉平下毒》的封面，标明其为《三国演义》系列的第十五部，由吉志西改编、钱笑呆绘画，画面描绘了吉平为病人下毒的场景。

内容提要
上集“煮酒论英雄”，叙曹操谈论天下大事，把刘备称为当今英雄。刘备怕曹操相害，借口征讨袁术，领兵离开许都，占领了徐州。
本集叙董承与太医吉平密谋，乘曹操头风病发，暗下毒药。曹操接到密告，诱捕吉平，酷刑拷打，追究主使。吉平抵死不承，触阶而亡。曹操杀尽董承等五家老小，又入宫缢死董贵妃，派兵把守宫廷，监视献帝君臣。
下集“白马坡”，叙关羽暂投曹操，连斩河北名将颜良、文丑。
1. 曹操击败诸侯，作了丞相，执掌着国家大权，更加作威作福。建安五年（公元200年）元旦，文武百官齐集朝廷，向献帝朝贺；曹操却在金銮殿上摇来摆去，什么人也不放在眼里。
page_text_en:
Content Summary
Last episode, "Discussing Heroes over Wine," narrates Cao Cao discussing major affairs of the world, calling Liu Bei the hero of today. Fearing harm from Cao Cao, Liu Bei used the pretext of attacking Yuan Shu, led his troops away from Xu Prefecture, and occupied Xuzhou.
This episode narrates how Dong Cheng and the imperial physician Ji Ping plotted to poison Cao Cao when he suffered a relapse of his headache. Upon receiving a secret report, Cao Cao lured and captured Ji Ping, tortured him severely, and sought the mastermind. Ji Ping refused to confess until death, and died by colliding with the steps. Cao Cao then killed all the family members of Dong Cheng and four other households, entered the palace to strangle Dong's concubine, stationed troops to guard the palace, and monitored the Emperor Xian and his ministers.
Next episode, "White Horse Slope," narrates how Guan Yu temporarily joined Cao Cao and successively killed the famous generals Yan Liang and Wen Chou of the northern region.
1. Cao Cao defeated the warlords, became the Chancellor, and held the nation's power, becoming even more tyrannical. In the first day of the fifth year of Jian'an (200 AD), civil and military officials gathered in the court to pay homage to Emperor Xian; yet Cao Cao swaggered on the Golden Pavilion, paying no heed to anyone.
summary_zh: 本页为绘本《吉平下毒》的第2页，上半部分是内容提要，简述了上集、本集和下集的剧情；下半部分是第一幅画面，描绘了建安五年元旦，文武百官向汉献帝朝贺，而曹操在金銮殿上傲慢地摇摆，不把任何人放在眼里。

2. 国舅董承自从受了衣带诏，日夜在心，只因力量薄弱，无法举动。这时见曹操这种目中无人的骄横态度，心里非常愤慨。
3. 这天退朝以后，董承约了王子服、吴子兰、种辑、吴硕四人来到府中，商议除掉曹操的计策，可是大家也没有办法。
page_text_en:
2. Since receiving the 'Cloth-Attached Edict', Minister Dong Cheng has been deeply troubled, but due to his weak position, he could not take action. Seeing Cao Cao's arrogant and disrespectful attitude, he felt extremely angry.
3. After court that day, Dong Cheng invited Wang Zifu, Wu Zilan, Zhong Ji, and Wu Shuo to his residence to discuss a plan to eliminate Cao Cao, but everyone was at a loss for a solution.
summary_zh: 本页描绘了董承因受衣带诏而心怀除曹之志，但因力量薄弱无法行动；退朝后，他召集王子服、吴子兰、种辑、吴硕四人商议除曹计策，却未能想出办法。

4. 董承心里愤慨、忧虑，又没有办法除掉曹操，过了一天，便病倒了。
5. 献帝听说董承有病，便派一位太医吉平来给他治病。
page_text_en:
4. Dong Cheng was filled with indignation and worry, yet had no way to eliminate Cao Cao; after a day, he fell ill.
5. Emperor Xian, hearing that Dong Cheng was sick, sent a court physician, Ji Ping, to treat him.
summary_zh: 董承因无法除掉曹操而忧愤成疾，病倒在床上；汉献帝得知后，派遣太医吉平前来为他诊治。

6. 吉平是当时名医，他留在董承家里，细心治疗，日夜不离。见董承长吁短叹，知道他有心事，但是不敢问他。
7. 到了正月十五那天，董承病已好些了，便和吉平一起喝酒，庆赏元宵。
page_text_en:
6. Ji Ping was a renowned doctor at the time. He stayed at Dong Cheng's home, treating him carefully day and night. Seeing Dong Cheng sighing and groaning, he knew he had something on his mind, but dared not ask him.
7. On the fifteenth day of the first lunar month, Dong Cheng's illness had improved somewhat, so he drank wine with Ji Ping to celebrate the Lantern Festival.
summary_zh: 本页描绘了太医吉平在董承家中日夜照料其病情，因见董承忧心忡忡而不敢询问；随后，董承病愈，与吉平一同饮酒庆祝元宵节。

8. 两人谈谈说说，喝到初更时候，董承觉得疲倦，就靠在榻上和衣而睡。
9. 董承睡了不多一会，忽然王子服、吴子兰、种辑、吴硕四人，前来求见，董承便把他们迎入书房。
page_text_en:
8. The two talked and drank until the first watch, when Dong Cheng felt tired and leaned on the couch to sleep in his clothes.
9. After Dong Cheng had slept for a short while, suddenly Wang Zifu, Wu Zilan, Zhong Ji, and Wu Shuo came to see him, and Dong Cheng welcomed them into his study.
summary_zh: 董承与吉平饮酒谈天至初更，董承因疲倦在榻上睡着；不久后，王子服、吴子兰、种辑、吴硕四人前来求见，董承将他们迎入书房。

10. 坐定后，王子服说：“国家大事，有办法了。”董承很是高兴，请他详细说明。王子服说：“刘表结连袁绍，起兵五十万，分十路杀来；马腾结连韩遂，起西凉军七十二万，从北路杀来。”
11. 董承忙问：“曹操怎样应付他们？”王子服说：“曹操尽起许昌兵马，分头迎击，城中空虚。他今夜还在相府大宴，庆祝元宵。我们聚五家的僮仆，冲入相府，杀死曹贼。不可失此机会！”，
page_text_en:
10. After sitting down, Wang Zifu said, "There is a way to handle the national crisis." Dong Cheng was very pleased and asked him to explain in detail. Wang Zifu said, "Liu Biao has allied with Yuan Shao, raising an army of 500,000 to attack from ten directions; Ma Teng has allied with Han Sui, raising 720,000 troops from the Western Liang region to attack from the north." 
11. Dong Cheng hurriedly asked, "How will Cao Cao respond to them?" Wang Zifu replied, "Cao Cao will mobilize all the troops in Xuchang to fight them in separate battles, leaving the city vulnerable. He is still holding a grand banquet at his mansion tonight to celebrate the Lantern Festival. We should gather the servants from the five families, rush into his mansion, and kill the traitor Cao. We must not miss this opportunity!"
summary_zh: 王子服向董承献计，提议联合刘表、袁绍和马腾、韩遂起兵攻打曹操，趁曹操在许昌大宴元宵、城中空虚之际，率五家僮仆冲入相府刺杀曹操。

12. 董承听了，大为欣喜，便叫家人收拾兵器，自己披挂上马，和王子服他们约在内门前相会，同时进兵。
13. 到了二更时候，各家兵马都已到齐，把丞相府四面包围。
page_text_en:
12. Dong Cheng, upon hearing this, was greatly delighted. He ordered his men to gather weapons, donned his armor, mounted his horse, and agreed to meet with Wang Zifu and others at the inner gate to launch a simultaneous attack.
13. By the second watch, the troops from all sides had arrived and surrounded the Chancellor's mansion on all four sides.
summary_zh: 董承听从王子服的计策后，立即准备兵器并披挂上马，与同谋者约定在内门前会合进攻；到了二更时分，各路兵马已集结完毕，将丞相府四面包围。

14. 董承手提宝剑，飞步直入相府，见曹操正在后堂大摆筵席，和宾客们饮酒作乐。
15. “仇人见面，分外眼红”，董承大叫：“曹操逆贼不要走！”对准曹操，一剑劈去，当把曹操劈倒地上。
page_text_en:
14. Dong Cheng, holding a precious sword, rushed into the Prime Minister's residence. He saw Cao Cao hosting a grand banquet in the back hall, drinking and enjoying himself with his guests.
15. 'When enemies meet, their eyes turn red with rage,' Dong Cheng shouted, 'Cao Cao, traitor, don't run!' He aimed at Cao Cao and swung his sword, striking him down to the ground.
summary_zh: 董承率众冲入曹操府邸，发现曹操正在后堂宴饮，随即挥剑冲向曹操，将其劈倒在地。

曹操逆贼，你也有今天吗？
16. 董承上前一步，正想去割取曹操的首级，忽然惊醒，原来是在做梦。
17. 吉平走到榻边，板着面孔高声问他道：“你要害死曹丞相吗？”董承惊慌得一时答不出话来。
page_text_en:
Cao Cao, traitor, will you also have this day?
16. Dong Cheng took a step forward, just about to cut off Cao Cao's head, when he suddenly woke up, realizing he had been dreaming.
17. Ji Ping walked to the side of the couch, his face stern, and loudly asked him, "Are you going to kill Chancellor Cao?" Dong Cheng was so startled that he couldn't speak for a moment.
summary_zh: 董承在梦中刺杀曹操后惊醒，随后太医吉平发现其异常，质问他是否要加害曹丞相，董承惊慌失措，无法回答。

18. 吉平看见董承的窘态，便安慰他道：“国舅不要恐慌，我虽然是个医生，也恨曹贼。你梦中的话我都已听见，请你不必隐瞒，倘有用得到我的地方，我愿意冒着灭族的危险去干。”
19. 董承感动得哭了起来。对吉平说：“只怕你不是真心！”
page_text_en:
18. Ji Ping saw Dong Cheng's distressed state and comforted him: "Lord Guo, do not be alarmed. Although I am a doctor, I also hate Cao Cao. I have heard your words from your dream. Please do not hide anything. If there is any use for me, I am willing to risk my family's destruction to do it."
19. Dong Cheng was moved to tears. He said to Ji Ping: "I only fear you are not sincere!"
summary_zh: 董承因梦中刺杀曹操而惊醒，太医吉平发现其异常并安慰他，表示自己也痛恨曹操，愿冒灭族之险相助；董承深受感动，担心吉平并非真心。

20. 吉平脸上，微微变色。他突然咬下一个手指，喷血道：“吉平决心杀贼，倘有反悔，天地不容！
21. 董承见吉平果然真心，便取出衣带诏来给他看。并且说：“现在刘备、马腾都远在他方，我因无计可施，因而忧虑成病。”
page_text_en:
20. Ji Ping's face turned slightly pale. He suddenly bit off a finger and spat blood, saying, "Ji Ping is determined to kill the traitor; if I ever regret this, may heaven and earth not forgive me!"
21. Dong Cheng, seeing that Ji Ping was truly sincere, took out the衣带诏 (imperial edict hidden in his sash) to show him. He said, "Now Liu Bei and Ma Teng are far away, and I have no way to act, so I have become ill from worry."
summary_zh: 吉平为表决心咬指喷血立誓，董承见其真心后，取出衣带诏相示，并说明因刘备、马腾远在异地而忧心成疾。

22. 吉平看过衣带诏，说：‘你们不必费心，曹操的性命，就在我手里。他常患头风，要我医治。只要我用一服毒药，就结果了他，何必动刀兵呢！’董承喜道：‘倘能如此，剪除奸臣就全靠你啦！’
23. 吉平告辞回去了。董承心中暗喜。走进后堂，发觉仆人秦庆童跟侍妾云英在暗地里窃窃私语。董承大怒，叫人把他们捉住，要杀死他们。
page_text_en:
22. Ji Ping looked at the诏 (imperial decree) tied to the sash, and said: 'You need not worry. Cao Cao's life is in my hands. He often suffers from headaches and needs me to treat him. If I just give him a dose of poison, I can end his life—why resort to weapons?' Dong Cheng rejoiced: 'If that can be done, eliminating the traitor will entirely depend on you!'
23. Ji Ping took his leave and departed. Dong Cheng was secretly delighted. As he entered the inner hall, he noticed his servant Qin Qingtong and concubine Yun Ying whispering secretly in the shadows. Dong Cheng became furious and ordered them to be seized, intending to kill them.
summary_zh: 吉平看完衣带诏后，提出用毒药暗杀曹操的计划，董承大喜；随后董承在后堂发现仆人秦庆童与侍妾云英私语，勃然大怒，下令捉拿并欲处死二人。

24. 夫人知道了这事，出来说情，才免了他们的死罪，各人责打四十大板，关入冷房。
25. 秦庆童心里怀恨，半夜里把冷房的铁锁扭断，爬过墙头，逃出董府。
page_text_en:
24. The lady learned of this matter, came out to plead for them, and thus they were spared the death penalty. Each was beaten forty times with a board and imprisoned in the cold room.
25. Qin Qingtong, filled with resentment, broke the iron lock of the cold room in the dead of night, climbed over the wall, and escaped from Dong's mansion.
summary_zh: 董承夫人出面求情，使秦庆童和云英免于死刑，但被责打并关入冷房；秦庆童怀恨在心，半夜扭断铁锁，翻墙逃出董府。

26. 他来到丞相府中，说有机密事报告。曹操把他带进密室，问他报告什么机密。
27. 秦庆童说：“王子服、吴子兰、种辑、吴硕、马腾五人，曾在董承府中商议，要谋害丞相。董承还拿出一段白绢，不知上面写些什么。今天又有个太医吉平在董承面前咬手指立誓呢。”
page_text_en:
26. He arrived at the Prime Minister's residence, claiming to have a secret report. Cao Cao brought him into a private room and asked what secret he had to report.
27. Qin Qingtong said: "Wang Zifu, Wu Zilan, Zhong Ji, Wu Shuo, and Ma Teng — five men — once met at Dong Cheng's residence to plot against the Prime Minister. Dong Cheng also took out a piece of white silk, and we don't know what was written on it. Today, a physician named Ji Ping even bit his finger and swore an oath before Dong Cheng!"
summary_zh: 秦庆童逃出董府后，来到丞相府密报，称董承与王子服、吴子兰、种辑、吴硕、马腾等人密谋刺杀曹操，并提及董承曾出示白绢诏书及太医吉平咬指立誓之事。

28. 曹操默默听着，脸色由红转青，由青转白，最后微微冷笑，吩咐庆童藏在相府，准备质对。
29. 第二天，曹操便装头痛，找吉平医治。吉平暗自欢喜，以为杀死曹操的机会到了。他暗中带了些毒药，来到丞相府中。
page_text_en:
28. Cao Cao listened silently, his face turning from red to green, then to white, finally giving a faint cold smile. He instructed Qing Tong to hide in the Prime Minister's mansion, preparing for confrontation.
29. The next day, Cao Cao pretended to have a headache and called for Ji Ping to treat him. Ji Ping secretly rejoiced, thinking the chance to kill Cao Cao had come. He secretly brought some poison and arrived at the Prime Minister's mansion.
summary_zh: 曹操听完密报后脸色剧变，吩咐庆童藏于府中准备质问；次日，曹操假装头痛召吉平诊治，吉平以为刺杀机会来临，暗带毒药前往丞相府。

30. 吉平看见曹操睡在床上，给他诊视了一下，便说病势不重，只要吃一服药就会好的。
31. 他还叫人拿来药罐，亲自给曹操煎药，煎到半干，暗暗放下毒药。
page_text_en:
30. Ji Ping saw Cao Cao sleeping in bed, examined him briefly, and said the illness was not serious, and that he would recover after taking one dose of medicine.
31. He then had someone bring a medicine pot, personally boiled the medicine for Cao Cao, and when it was half-dried, secretly added the poison.
summary_zh: 吉平为曹操诊病，称其病势不重，随后亲自煎药并在药中暗下毒药，企图刺杀曹操。

title_zh: 连环画《三国演义15：吉平下毒》
title_en: Comic Series 'Romance of the Three Kingdoms 15: Ji Ping Poisons'
source_file: 连环画《三国演义15：吉平下毒》（7-11岁）.pdf
page_text_ocr_zh:
32. 然后倒出药汁，亲自送给曹操。
33. 曹操知道药内有毒，故意延迟不服。吉平劝他说：“把药乘热服了，出些汗，病就好啦！”
page_text_en:
32. Then he poured out the medicine and personally brought it to Cao Cao.
33. Cao Cao knew the medicine was poisoned, so he deliberately delayed taking it. Ji Ping urged him, "Take the medicine while it's hot, sweat a little, and your illness will be cured!"
summary_zh: 吉平将毒药煎好后亲自送给曹操，曹操识破药中有毒，故意拖延不喝，吉平劝他趁热服下。

title_zh: 连环画《三国演义15：吉平下毒》
title_en: Comic Series 'Romance of the Three Kingdoms 15: Ji Ping Poisons'
source_file: 连环画《三国演义15：吉平下毒》（7-11岁）.pdf

34. 曹操突然坐起，对吉平说：“皇帝有病吃药，臣子要先尝一下，父亲有病吃药，儿子要先尝一下；你是我的心腹人，何以不先尝一下呢！”吉平说：“药是治病的，何必要别人先尝。
35. 曹操冷笑一声，吉平知道秘密已经泄露，就大步上前，扯着曹操的耳朵，用强灌药。
page_text_en:
34. Cao Cao suddenly sat up and said to Ji Ping, "When the emperor takes medicine, the minister must taste it first; when a father takes medicine, the son must taste it first. You are my trusted man, why don't you taste it first?" Ji Ping replied, "Medicine is for curing illness, why should someone else taste it first?"
35. Cao Cao sneered coldly. Ji Ping realized the secret had been exposed, so he stepped forward, grabbed Cao Cao's ear, and tried to force-feed him the medicine.
summary_zh: 曹操识破吉平下毒，要求他先尝药，吉平拒绝后，曹操冷笑，吉平意识到秘密泄露，强行灌药。

title_zh: 连环画《三国演义15：吉平下毒》
title_en: Comic Series 'Romance of the Three Kingdoms 15: Ji Ping Poisons'
source_file: 连环画《三国演义15：吉平下毒》（7-11岁）.pdf

36. 曹操用手一推，把药泼翻地上；药力猛烈，霎时间连砖块也裂开了。
37. 曹操的侍卫便拥上来把吉平抓住。曹操奸笑一声，对吉平说：“我哪里有病，特地试试你的；你果然想来害我！”
page_text_en:
36. Cao Cao pushed the medicine with his hand, spilling it on the ground; the potency was so fierce that bricks cracked instantly.
37. Cao Cao's guards rushed forward and seized Ji Ping. Cao Cao sneered and said to Ji Ping, "I don't have any illness; I tested you deliberately. You truly intended to harm me!"
summary_zh: 曹操识破吉平下毒，将药泼翻在地，药力猛烈裂开砖块，随后侍卫抓住吉平，曹操揭露其刺杀阴谋。

title_zh: 连环画《三国演义15：吉平下毒》
title_en: Comic Series 'Romance of the Three Kingdoms 15: Ji Ping Poisons'

38. 曹操便命二十个精壮的狱卒，把吉平架到后园去拷打。吉平忍住疼痛，一声不响。

你是一个祸国害民的逆贼，天下人都要杀你，用不到指使！

你为什么要毒害我呢？一定有人指使你的，你说出那个人来，我就饶你。

39. 拷打完了，推上亭子。曹操高坐在上，要吉平供出主使的人来。吉平面不改色，只是谩骂。
page_text_en:
38. Cao Cao ordered twenty strong prison guards to take Ji Ping to the back garden and torture him. Ji Ping endured the pain silently, not uttering a sound.

You are a traitor who brings disaster to the country and harms the people. Everyone under heaven wants to kill you—no one needs to order you!

Why do you want to poison me? Someone must have ordered you. Name that person, and I will spare you.

39. After the torture, they pushed Ji Ping onto the pavilion. Cao Cao sat high above, demanding that Ji Ping reveal who had ordered him. Ji Ping remained calm and only cursed him.
summary_zh: 曹操命人将吉平拷打后推上亭子审问，逼其供出主使之人，吉平宁死不屈，只以谩骂回应。

title_zh: 连环画《三国演义15：吉平下毒》

source_file: 连环画《三国演义15：吉平下毒》（7-11岁）.pdf

40. 曹操令狱卒把吉平吊在亭上，边打边问。吉平只说：“是我要杀你，没有人指使！”足足拷打了两个时辰，打得他皮开肉裂，血流满地，他并不改口。
41. 曹操只怕打死了吉平没有对证，才令狱卒放下，把他揪下亭去，关进监牢。
page_text_en:
40. Cao Cao ordered the jailers to hang Ji Ping in the pavilion and beat him while interrogating him. Ji Ping only said, “It was I who wanted to kill you, no one ordered me!” He was tortured for two full time periods, beaten until his skin split and blood flowed everywhere, yet he did not change his story.
41. Cao Cao, fearing that killing Ji Ping would leave no evidence, ordered the jailers to lower him, dragged him down from the pavilion, and locked him in prison.
summary_zh: 曹操将吉平吊在亭上严刑拷打，吉平宁死不屈，只承认自己所为；曹操因担心无证，最终将吉平关进监牢。

42. 第二天，曹操在府中大摆筵席，请各位大臣饮酒。王子服、吴子兰、种辑、吴硕恐怕曹操生疑也都来了，只有董承托病不到。
43. 席间，曹操对众大臣说：‘今天没有什么作乐，我有一个人，可以为众大臣醒酒。’说着，便吩咐左右把吉平带来！
page_text_en:
42. The next day, Cao Cao held a grand banquet in his mansion, inviting all the ministers to drink. Wang Zifu, Wu Zilan, Zhong Ji, and Wu Shuo, fearing suspicion from Cao Cao, all came, but Dong Cheng feigned illness and did not attend.
43. During the banquet, Cao Cao said to the ministers, 'Today, there is no entertainment. I have someone who can help you sober up.' Saying this, he ordered his attendants to bring Ji Ping!
summary_zh: 曹操在府中设宴款待大臣，唯独董承托病未到。席间，曹操声称有能为众人醒酒之人，命人将吉平带来。

title_zh: 连环画《三国演义15：吉平下毒》
title_en: Comic Series 'Romance of the Three Kingdoms 15: Ji Ping Poisons'
source_file: 连环画《三国演义15：吉平下毒》（7-11岁）.pdf

44. 一会儿，吉平被带到阶前。曹操说：“这人结连恶党，背叛朝廷，要将我谋害；现在阴谋失败，请大家听听他的供词。”
45. 曹操叫狱卒把吉平先痛打一顿，打得他昏了过去。
page_text_en:
44. After a while, Ji Ping was brought before Cao Cao. Cao Cao said, "This man has allied with evil factions, betrayed the court, and plotted to assassinate me. Now that his conspiracy has failed, please listen to his confession."
45. Cao Cao ordered the jailers to beat Ji Ping severely, knocking him unconscious.
summary_zh: 曹操在宴会上将吉平带到阶前，指控其结党谋害，并命狱卒将其痛打至昏厥。

title_zh: 连环画《三国演义15：吉平下毒》
title_en: Comic Series 'Romance of the Three Kingdoms 15: Ji Ping Poisons'
source_file: 连环画《三国演义15：吉平下毒》（7-11岁）.pdf
page_text_ocr_zh:
我不能杀死你
这个逆贼，是国家的不幸……
46. 然后用冷水在他脸上一喷，吉平又苏醒过来。曹操问道：“和你同谋的还有六个人，老实供来！”吉平只是大骂。
47. 曹操吩咐狱卒一面打，一面喷水，把吉平百般摧残。吉平并不求饶，依然骂不绝口。
page_text_en:
I cannot kill you
This traitor is a misfortune for the nation...
46. Then, cold water was sprayed on his face, and Ji Ping woke up again. Cao Cao asked, "Who else is involved with you? Confess honestly!" Ji Ping only cursed.
47. Cao Cao ordered the jailers to beat him while spraying water, torturing Ji Ping mercilessly. Ji Ping did not beg for mercy and continued to curse without pause.
summary_zh: 曹操对被拷打昏厥的吉平施以冷水浇醒，并逼问同谋，吉平宁死不屈，继续辱骂；曹操命狱卒一面打、一面喷水，对吉平进行残酷折磨，吉平始终不求饶，骂声不绝。

title_zh: 连环画《三国演义15：吉平下毒》

48. 座上的大臣们有的把头低下，不忍再看。王子服他们四，看到这个情形，好如坐在针毡上一般，感到非常不安。
49. 曹操眼看无法制服吉平，只得命狱卒把他带下。
page_text_en:
48. The ministers seated at the table some lowered their heads, unable to bear watching. Wang Zifu and his three companions, seeing this scene, felt as if sitting on a bed of nails, extremely uneasy.
49. Cao Cao, seeing he could not subdue Ji Ping, had no choice but to order the jailers to take him away.
summary_zh: 大臣们目睹吉平被严刑拷打，感到不安；曹操因无法使其屈服，只得命狱卒将他带下。

title_zh: 连环画《三国演义15：吉平下毒》
title_en: Comic Series 'Romance of the Three Kingdoms 15: Ji Ping Poisons'
source_file: 连环画《三国演义15：吉平下毒》（7-11岁）.pdf

50. 众大臣散席以后，曹操只留王子服、吴子兰、种辑、吴硕四人夜宴。四人吓得魂不附体，只得留下。
51. 席间，曹操问王子服他们，在董承家里商量些什么事情？他们都说没有这事。
没有这回事。
你们在白绢上写的什么？
page_text_en:
50. After the other ministers left the banquet, Cao Cao only kept Wang Zifu, Wu Zilan, Zhong Ji, and Wu Shuo for a private night feast. The four were terrified and had no choice but to stay.
51. During the feast, Cao Cao asked Wang Zifu and the others what they had discussed at Dong Cheng's house. They all said, 'There was nothing.'
There was nothing.
What did you write on the white silk?
summary_zh: 曹操在宴席后单独留下王子服等四人夜宴，质问他们在董承家商量何事，四人否认并称无事。

title_zh: 连环画《三国演义15：吉平下毒》

52. 曹操当即把秦庆童唤来作证。王子服问秦庆童：“你在哪里看到？”秦庆童说：“你们避了众人，在一处划字，怎么赖得。”
53. 吴子兰对曹操说：“这个无耻的家伙，和董承的侍妾通奸，受了主人的责罚，因此诬告主人，丞相别听他的话。”
page_text_en:
52. Cao Cao immediately summoned Qin Qingtong to testify. Wang Zifu asked Qin Qingtong, 'Where did you see it?' Qin Qingtong replied, 'You avoided everyone and wrote something in a hidden place—how can you deny it?'
53. Wu Zilan told Cao Cao, 'This shameless fellow had an affair with Dong Cheng's concubine, was punished by his master, and is now falsely accusing his master. Chancellor, don't believe him.'
summary_zh: 曹操在宴席上召来秦庆童作证，王子服质问其目击细节，秦庆童指证董承等人密谋；随后吴子兰为吉平辩解，称其因与董承侍妾通奸受罚而诬告主人，劝曹操勿信。

title_zh: 连环画《三国演义15：吉平下毒》

source_file: 连环画《三国演义15：吉平下毒》（7-11岁）.pdf

54. 曹操说：“那末吉平下毒，不是董承指使，是谁指使的呢？”王子服他们都说不知道这事。曹操变色道：“乘早实说，还可宽恕；等到事发，死罪难逃。”四人哪里肯认。
55. 曹操大怒，命左右将他们四人抓起来，送到监狱里关着。
page_text_en:
54. Cao Cao said, "If Ji Ping poisoned the wine, and it wasn't Dong Cheng who ordered it, then who was behind it?" Wang Zifu and the others all said they didn't know. Cao Cao changed color and said, "Confess now and you may be pardoned; but if the matter comes to light, you will face death." The four refused to admit anything.
55. Cao Cao became furious and ordered his attendants to seize the four men and send them to prison.
summary_zh: 曹操质问王子服等四人吉平下毒的主使，四人否认，曹操大怒，命人将他们抓入监狱。

56. 第二天，曹操带了许多侍卫来到董承家里探病。董承只得出来迎接。
57. 曹操进堂坐了，便问董承昨天为什么不来赴宴。董承说：‘有病不敢轻易出外。’曹操冷笑一声说：‘是忧国家的病吧？’董承听了，吃了一惊。
page_text_en:
56. The next day, Cao Cao brought many guards to Dong Cheng's house to visit him. Dong Cheng had no choice but to come out to greet him.
57. After Cao Cao sat down in the hall, he asked Dong Cheng why he hadn't come to the banquet yesterday. Dong Cheng said, 'I was ill and dared not go out easily.' Cao Cao coldly laughed and said, 'Are you worried about the illness of the nation?' Dong Cheng was startled upon hearing this.
summary_zh: 曹操带侍卫到董承家探病，董承被迫迎接。曹操质问董承为何未赴宴，董承称病，曹操冷笑暗示其忧国，董承闻言震惊。

58. 曹操又问董承：“国舅可知道吉平的事情？”董承回说不知。曹操便吩咐左右：“把吉平带上来给国舅起病。”董承知道事情败露，心里慌乱得不知怎么办才好。
59. 一会儿，狱卒把吉平推到阶下。吉平大骂：“曹操逆贼！为什么不杀我！”
page_text_en:
58. Cao Cao asked Dong Cheng again, 'Does the Imperial Uncle know about Ji Ping's matter?' Dong Cheng replied that he did not know. Cao Cao then ordered his attendants, 'Bring Ji Ping up to cure the Imperial Uncle's illness.' Dong Cheng, realizing the plot had been exposed, was panicked and didn't know what to do.
59. After a while, the jailers pushed Ji Ping down to the steps. Ji Ping shouted, 'Cao Cao, traitor! Why don't you kill me!'
summary_zh: 曹操质问董承是否知晓吉平之事，董承否认，曹操命人将吉平带至面前；随后狱卒将吉平推至阶下，吉平怒骂曹操为逆贼。

60. 曹操对董承说：“他已供出王子服等四人，我已把他们逮捕了；还有一个人未曾抓住。”
61. 便问吉平：“谁是主使？赶快招出！”吉平大叫道：“天使我来杀逆贼！”曹操大怒，吩咐左右把吉平痛打。可怜吉平被打得身上没有一寸好肉，浑身像个血人。董承看了，心里痛得像刀割一般。
page_text_en:
60. Cao Cao said to Dong Cheng: "He has confessed to Wang Zifu and three others; I have already arrested them; there is still one person who has not been caught."
61. He then asked Ji Ping: "Who is the mastermind? Confess quickly!" Ji Ping shouted: "Heaven sent me to kill the traitor!" Cao Cao became furious and ordered his attendants to beat Ji Ping severely. Poor Ji Ping was beaten so badly that not an inch of his body was unharmed, his whole body like a blood-soaked man. Dong Cheng watched and felt his heart ache as if cut by a knife.
summary_zh: 曹操向董承通报已逮捕王子服等四人，尚有一人未捕；随后逼问吉平主谋，吉平宁死不屈，大喊‘天使我来杀逆贼’，曹操大怒命人痛打，吉平遍体鳞伤，董承见状心痛如割。

63. 狱卒就在阶下把吉平的手指一齐剁下。吉平当时就痛得昏迷过去。

62. Cao Cao asked Ji Ping again, 'You once had ten fingers. Why do you now have only nine?' Ji Ping shouted, 'I bite my fingers to swear I will kill the traitor who harms the country and its people!' Cao Cao ordered the jailer to bring a knife: 'Cut them all off, so you can swear!' 
63. The jailer then chopped off all of Ji Ping's fingers at the steps. Ji Ping immediately fainted from the pain.
summary_zh: 曹操逼问吉平手指缺失原因，吉平立誓要杀逆贼，曹操命狱卒将其手指全部砍下，吉平痛昏过去。

page_text_en:
64. Cao Cao ordered cold water to be sprayed on him to wake him up. Ji Ping shouted, "I still have a mouth to swallow the traitor, a tongue to curse the traitor, and a heart to hate the traitor!"

summary_zh: 曹操命人用冷水将昏厥的吉平喷醒，吉平仍怒骂不屈；曹操大怒，下令割开吉平的口、剁下他的舌头，狱卒随即动手。

66. 吉平叫道：“且慢动手。我现在熬不住你的毒刑，就招供吧！快把我的刑具去掉。”
67. 曹操谅吉平也无法逃跑，便命左右把他的刑具打开。

66. Ji Ping shouted, 'Wait a moment! I can't endure your cruel torture any longer. I'll confess! Quickly remove my restraints.'
67. Cao Cao, believing Ji Ping could not escape, ordered his attendants to remove Ji Ping's restraints.
summary_zh: 吉平在酷刑下请求停止并愿意招供，曹操认为他无法逃跑，便命人解开他的刑具。

title_zh: 连环画《三国演义15：吉平下毒》
title_en: Comic Series 'Romance of the Three Kingdoms 15: Ji Ping Poisons'
source_file: 连环画《三国演义15：吉平下毒》（7-11岁）.pdf
page_text_ocr_zh:
68. 曹操只等吉平招供，不料他高声叫道：“我不能为国家除去逆贼，这是我的终身遗憾！
69. 然后把头向阶沿上猛撞过去。曹操急忙叫人扯住，吉平已经撞得头破血流而死。
page_text_en:
68. Cao Cao was waiting for Ji Ping to confess, but unexpectedly, he shouted loudly: 'I cannot remove the traitor for the country; this is my lifelong regret!'
69. Then he violently slammed his head against the step. Cao Cao hurriedly ordered people to hold him back, but Ji Ping had already died from a head injury and bleeding.
summary_zh: 吉平在遭受酷刑后仍不招供，高呼为国除贼是其终身遗憾，随后撞向阶沿自尽，曹操急忙命人拉住，但吉平已头破血流而亡。

title_zh: 连环画《三国演义15：吉平下毒》
title_en: Comic Series 'Romance of the Three Kingdoms 15: Ji Ping Poisons'
source_file: 连环画《三国演义15：吉平下毒》（7-11岁）.pdf
page_text_ocr_zh:
70. 曹操见吉平已死，命狱卒把秦庆童带到面前，便问董承道：“国舅认识这人吗？”董承见了，怒气冲冲地说：“这是我家犯了家规的逃奴，应该把他杀死！
71. 曹操说：“他告发了阴谋造反的人们，现在来作对证，哪个人敢杀他！”董承说：“丞相为什么要听那逃奴一面之言呢？”
page_text_en:
70. Cao Cao saw Ji Ping was already dead, ordered the jailer to bring Qin Qingtong before him, and asked Dong Cheng, 'Do you recognize this man, Uncle?' Dong Cheng, seeing him, angrily said, 'This is a runaway slave from my household who broke our family rules; he should be killed!
71. Cao Cao said, 'He has exposed those plotting rebellion; now he comes as a witness. Who dares to kill him?' Dong Cheng replied, 'Why should you, Chancellor, believe the one-sided words of a runaway slave?'
summary_zh: 曹操将秦庆童带到董承面前，称其为告发谋反者的证人，董承则怒斥其为逃奴并主张处死，双方各执一词，矛盾激化。

title_zh: 连环画《三国演义15：吉平下毒》
title_en: Comic Series 'Romance of the Three Kingdoms 15: Ji Ping Poisons'
source_file: 连环画《三国演义15：吉平下毒》（7-11岁）.pdf
page_text_ocr_zh:
72. 曹操冷笑道：“王子服等都已供认，你还敢抵赖！”当即喝令左右把董承拿下。
73. 曹操派人在董承的卧房内，搜出衣带诏和义状。曹操看了，笑着说：“这些没用的家伙，竟敢这样胆大妄为！“
page_text_en:
72. Cao Cao sneered, "Wang Zifu and others have already confessed. How dare you still deny it!" He immediately ordered his attendants to seize Dong Cheng.
73. Cao Cao sent people to search Dong Cheng's bedroom and found the衣带诏 (Imperial Edict in the Sash) and the declaration of rebellion. After reading them, Cao Cao laughed and said, "These useless fellows, how dare they act so boldly and recklessly!"
summary_zh: 曹操以王子服等人已供认谋反为由，下令拿下董承，并在董承卧房内搜出衣带诏和义状，得意地嘲讽其胆大妄为。

title_zh: 连环画《三国演义15：吉平下毒》
title_en: Comic Series 'Romance of the Three Kingdoms 15: Ji Ping Poisons'
source_file: 连环画《三国演义15：吉平下毒》（7-11岁）.pdf
page_text_ocr_zh:
74. 当把董承全家老小，一起拿下。
75. 又把王子服、吴子兰、种辑、吴硕的家属捉到。五家老小七百多人，都被押送各城门杀了。城里的居民见了，没有一个不流眼泪。
page_text_en:
74. Immediately, Dong Cheng's entire family, young and old, were seized.
75. Then, the families of Wang Zifu, Wu Zilan, Zhong Ji, and Wu Shuo were also captured. Over seven hundred people from the five families were taken to the city gates and executed. The city's residents, upon seeing this, not one failed to shed tears.
summary_zh: 曹操下令逮捕董承全家，并将王子服、吴子兰、种辑、吴硕等五家的七百多名家属押送至城门处斩，百姓见状无不落泪。

title_zh: 连环画《三国演义15：吉平下毒》
title_en: Comic Series 'Romance of the Three Kingdoms 15: Ji Ping Poisons'
source_file: 连环画《三国演义15：吉平下毒》（7-11岁）.pdf
page_text_ocr_zh:
丞相奉了汉家的名号，才能威震四海，号令天下。现在诸侯未平，就做这废立君主的事，一定会引起变乱。
76. 曹操杀了五家老小，怒气未消。他召集谋士商议，要废献帝，另立新君。程昱意图劝阻，说明利害，他才打消了这个主意。
77. 第二天，曹操带剑入宫；守卫宫殿的御林军，谁也不敢阻挡他。
page_text_en:
The Chancellor, by upholding the name of the Han dynasty, can command respect throughout the four seas and rule over the world. Now that the warlords have not yet been pacified, to carry out the act of deposing and replacing the sovereign would surely cause chaos.
76. Cao Cao, after killing the families of five households, was still furious. He summoned his strategists to discuss deposing Emperor Xian and installing a new ruler. Cheng Yu tried to dissuade him by explaining the dangers, and only then did he abandon the idea.
77. The next day, Cao Cao entered the palace with a sword; the imperial guards stationed there dared not stop him.
summary_zh: 曹操在诛杀五家后欲废汉献帝另立新君，被程昱劝阻后放弃；次日，曹操带剑入宫，御林军无人敢阻拦。

title_zh: 连环画《三国演义15：吉平下毒》
title_en: Comic Series 'Romance of the Three Kingdoms 15: Ji Ping Poisons'
source_file: 连环画《三国演义15：吉平下毒》（7-11岁）.pdf
page_text_ocr_zh:
78. 献帝看见曹操面有怒容，不禁大惊失色，慌忙下座来迎。
79. 曹操问献帝：“董承阴谋造反，陛下知道吗？”献帝答道：“董卓已经处死了。”曹操大声道：“是董承！不是董卓！”
page_text_en:
78. The Emperor Xian, seeing Cao Cao's angry expression, was greatly alarmed and hurriedly got up to greet him.
79. Cao Cao asked the Emperor: "Dong Cheng has plotted rebellion. Does Your Majesty know?" The Emperor replied: "Dong Zhuo has already been executed." Cao Cao shouted: "It's Dong Cheng! Not Dong Zhuo!"
summary_zh: 曹操带剑入宫，面有怒容，汉献帝惊慌迎上前。曹操质问献帝是否知晓董承谋反，献帝误以为其指董卓，曹操当即纠正并强调是董承。

title_zh: 连环画《三国演义15：吉平下毒》
title_en: Comic Series 'Romance of the Three Kingdoms 15: Ji Ping Poisons'
source_file: 连环画《三国演义15：吉平下毒》（7-11岁）.pdf
page_text_ocr_zh:
80. 献帝颤声道：“我一点也不知。”曹操冷笑一声，说：“忘了咬破手指写诏书的事吗？”献帝听了，浑身乱颤。
81. 曹操回头向武士喝道：“把董承的亲妹拿来！”武士便向内宫奔去。
page_text_en:
80. The Emperor Xian trembled and said, "I know nothing about it." Cao Cao sneered and said, "Have you forgotten the matter of biting your finger to write the edict?" The Emperor, upon hearing this, trembled all over.
81. Cao Cao turned and shouted to the warriors, "Bring out Dong Cheng's younger sister!" The warriors then rushed toward the inner palace.
summary_zh: 曹操质问汉献帝是否知晓董承谋反，提及咬破手指写诏书之事，献帝惊恐不已；随后曹操命令武士去内宫抓董承的妹妹。

title_zh: 连环画《三国演义15：吉平下毒》
title_en: Comic Series 'Romance of the Three Kingdoms 15: Ji Ping Poisons'
source_file: 连环画《三国演义15：吉平下毒》（7-11岁）.pdf
page_text_ocr_zh:
82. 不一会，拿到了董贵妃。献帝哀求说：“她已有五月身孕，望丞相垂怜！”曹操说：“他们要谋害我，我不能留下祸根！”
83. 献帝只管流泪。伏皇后也来哀求道：“且把贵妃贬入冷宫，等她分了娩，再行处治。”曹操怒道：“要留这个逆种，替他母亲报仇吗？”
page_text_en:
82. Soon after, Dong Guifei was captured. The Emperor Xian pleaded, "She is five months pregnant; I beg you, Chancellor, to show mercy!" Cao Cao replied, "They plotted to harm me; I cannot leave a source of trouble!"
83. The Emperor Xian only wept. Empress Fu also pleaded, "Let us first demote the concubine to the cold palace, wait until she gives birth, and then deal with her." Cao Cao angrily retorted, "Do you want to keep this traitor's offspring to avenge his mother?"
summary_zh: 曹操抓捕董贵妃，汉献帝和伏皇后恳求宽恕，但曹操坚持要除掉潜在威胁，认为其为祸根。

title_zh: 连环画《三国演义15：吉平下毒》
title_en: Comic Series 'Romance of the Three Kingdoms 15: Ji Ping Poisons'
source_file: 连环画《三国演义15：吉平下毒》（7-11岁）.pdf
page_text_ocr_zh:
84. 董贵妃眼看不能活命，流泪道：“让我留一个全尸，不要牵出去杀吧。”曹操拿了一条白汗巾，丢在她的面前。
85. 董贵妃拾起汗巾，抖得寸步难移。献帝心如刀割，哽咽着说：“贵妃，你不要怨我……”说着，泪如雨下；伏皇后也痛哭起来。
page_text_en:
84. Empress Dong, seeing that she could not survive, wept and said, "Let me die with a whole body; don't drag me out to be killed." Cao Cao took a white handkerchief and threw it in front of her.
85. Empress Dong picked up the handkerchief, trembling so much she could hardly move. Emperor Xian, heartbroken, choked out, "Empress, don't blame me..." As he spoke, tears streamed down his face; Empress Fu also burst into sobs.
summary_zh: 董贵妃被曹操抓捕，请求留全尸，曹操丢给她一条白汗巾；董贵妃拾起汗巾后颤抖不已，汉献帝心痛落泪，伏皇后亦痛哭。

title_zh: 连环画《三国演义15：吉平下毒》
title_en: Comic Series 'Romance of the Three Kingdoms 15: Ji Ping Poisons'
source_file: 连环画《三国演义15：吉平下毒》（7-11岁）.pdf
page_text_ocr_zh:
86. 曹操怒道：“还做这种小孩子样子干什么！”便令武士把贵妃牵出，勒死在宫门之外。
87. 曹操吩咐监宫官：“以后所有王亲国戚，没有我的命令，如果擅自入宫，便砍脑袋，守御不严，同等论罪。”监宫官连连称是，不敢违抗。
page_text_en:
86. Cao Cao angrily said, “What are you doing, acting like a child!” He then ordered the warriors to drag the noble concubine out and strangle her outside the palace gate.
87. Cao Cao instructed the palace guard commander, “From now on, all royal relatives and nobles must not enter the palace without my command. If anyone does so, their head will be cut off. If the guards fail to prevent it, they will be punished equally.” The guard commander nodded repeatedly in agreement, daring not to disobey.
summary_zh: 曹操下令将董贵妃勒死于宫门之外，并警告监宫官严守宫门，禁止王亲国戚擅自入宫，违者斩首。

title_zh: 连环画《三国演义15：吉平下毒》

88. 曹操又命曹洪统领三千个心腹兵将，充当守卫宫殿的御林军，严密监视献帝。
89. 曹操处理完毕，才走出宫门，怒气冲冲地坐在车中，回相府去了。欲知后事，请看下集《白马坡》
page_text_en:
88. Cao Cao then ordered Cao Hong to lead three thousand trusted soldiers to serve as the imperial guards, strictly monitoring Emperor Xian.
89. After finishing his affairs, Cao Cao left the palace gate, angrily sitting in his carriage, returning to his prime minister's residence. To learn what happens next, please read the next chapter, 'Baima Slope'.
summary_zh: 曹操命曹洪统领三千心腹兵将守卫宫殿，严密监视汉献帝；处理完毕后，曹操怒气冲冲地乘车返回相府。
